title: Kannur University Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Doctor and Nurse Posts
description: Kannur University has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 02 Doctor and Nurse Jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for this post before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MBBS, B.sc Nursing, or GNM can apply for the Kannur University Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply online.
